At the moment its limits are whatever the first draft chose. The budget is 200,000 tokens and 30 calls. I'd want that to be a decision you made.

- Preflight.
- Reading one real answer.
- The real evaluation.
- Deploy.

Nothing real has run, so nothing has cost money yet. Preflight comes before the first paid run.
